description: Use this when designing an SDK component that admits work (publish, submit, send, fan-out) faster than its downstream can drain — picking between bounded-channel block, ErrQueueFull fail-fast, or counted-drop policy. Covers semaphores, bounded worker queues, JetStream MaxAckPending, and size heuristics. Triggers: backpressure, bounded channel, semaphore, ErrQueueFull, MaxQueueSize, drop, block, flow control, ants, x/sync/semaphore.
